summary.text: Libby Blackburn is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has been an at-large member of the North Allegheny School District school board since 2011.

paragraphs.text: Libby Blackburn graduated from North Allegheny High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Kenyon College in 1986.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in the district for more than 50 years, also studied at Bucknell University, and had a 27-year career at American Airlines (formerly USAirways).
She said her community roles have included PTO president at Ingomar Elementary, chair of the NA Foundation, volunteer with the Ingomar Franklin Park Athletic Association and church ministry leader.
Blackburn assumed office on the North Allegheny school board in 2011, and her current term ends in 2027.
She said she has also served 13 years at the A.W. Beattie Career Center.
She advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

Her stated campaign priorities are affordability and long-term fiscal responsibility, a fair funding formula for education, and transparency in government; she said she hopes to serve on the House Education Committee.
